title: Slug Sage Mode
body:
Syntax: sage train slug  |  sage on slug  |  sage off

Description: Sign the permanent Slug contract at its elder in Shikkotsu Forest, then reach level 80 and train there to 100% mastery. Restores up to 5% of maximum Health each combat round while active. All Sage Modes grant 20% damage, +10 accuracy, and 10% less incoming damage. Active upkeep is 12 Chakra every 10 seconds out of combat or 16 Chakra and 8 Stamina per combat round. See 'help sage training' for the mastery process.

Date: 2026-09-27
